blocks.title: daily.dev | Where developers grow together
blocks.description: daily dev is a professional network for developers to learn, collaborate, and grow together. Developers come to daily.dev to discover a wide variety of professional knowledge, create groups where they can collaborate with other developers they appreciate, and discuss the latest trends in the developer ecosystem.

blocks.title: Hashnode - where developer blogs meet community power!
blocks.description: Hashnode is your go-to community to connect with other developers worldwide. It offers a platform to read and learn from high-quality tech and programming articles, engage in discussions, and even start your own dev blog. Start your journey of learning, sharing, and growing with Hashnode today!
